MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 15

5. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 3
   D. 4

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

13. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 8

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

17. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

19. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

20. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

21. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

22. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

24. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

25. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

26. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

27. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

28. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 25

29. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 4

30. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
